subject: Adopt Me!

official_sources.note: Official Roblox experience page by Uplift Games.
Uplift Games FAQ for Promo Codes, merchandise codes and the in-game kiosk.

codes.caption: Adopt Me!: reported code and current source conflict

cells.Context: Current trackers disagree; Freetins did not redeem it. Not a pet.

disagreements.source_a: GamesRadar reported PROUDFROG as working after a November 3, 2026 check.
disagreements.source_b: BloxDesk reported no active public code after a November 10, 2026 check and placed PROUDFROG in its expired list.
disagreements.confirmed: Both sources identify the reward as a Proud Frog Sticker. Freetins did not redeem the code and does not resolve the availability conflict.

unverified_summary: Current trackers disagree about whether PROUDFROG still works. GamesRadar reports it as active, while BloxDesk reports no active public code. Both describe a Proud Frog Sticker, not a pet. Freetins did not redeem the code, so the kiosk response remains unrecorded here.

next_change.pattern: Publisher announcements can change rewards and requirements. No fixed code-release schedule is established.
